notes.title: 🎮 Try the DEMO of SHADOWS IN THE SILENCE
notes.content: [p][b]👋Hello everyone[/b][/p][p]I am happy to announce that the free [b]DEMO of Shadows in the Silence[/b] is finally available playable and testable 🎮 Good nightmare to all 😉[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674446/4561a9d8e4214d097f79ee3a7836de2d76dc42bc.jpg"][/img][b]Please[/b], after testing it, [b]leave reviews here on Steam[/b] so that we can improve the title, if necessary, before the [b]official release[/b].💪[/p]
